live_lost_body: The burrow stopped answering: what you see is from its last answer. Trying again every few seconds.
live_never: The burrow does not answer. Check that clapier is running, then try again.
rabbits_empty_hint: One boot is enough: as soon as a rabbit asks for its bytecode or pulses on the network, it shows up here.
rabbit_no_mac_hint: Heard on the network, not named yet: its gestures arrive with its next request to the burrow.
reboot_body: The rabbit reloads its bytecode from the burrow: about thirty seconds without it.
dance_library_empty: No choreography in the burrow yet.
dance_compose_help: The Violet API dialect, comma-separated values.
error_bad_ip: That IP address is not valid.
error_bad_mac: That MAC address is not valid.
error_unknown_rabbit: That rabbit is not (or no longer) in the burrow.
error_no_reply: No reply: rebooting, dancing hard, or asleep.
error_cmd_not_allowed: That command is not allowed from here.
error_vol_floor: Volume stays at 40 or above: the power supply remembers.
error_no_overlay: No overlay to write into: start clapier with --overlay.
error_install_failed: Could not install the choreography in the burrow.
name_forgotten: The rabbit has no name anymore.
error_name_chars: A name fits on one line.
error_name_failed: Could not write the name into the burrow.
fw_running_unknown: Its firmware does not say which build it is.
fw_library_empty: No firmware in the burrow yet: add a .sim file.
fw_check_help: Check has the rabbit fetch and verify the image, and writes nothing.
fw_checking: {name} fetches the image to check it: the verdict shows here within a minute.
fw_flashing: {name} fetches the image and will flash it once verified. Do not unplug it.
fw_flash_body: {image} replaces its whole firmware. The rabbit verifies it first, then goes dark for about a minute. There is no bootloader behind a flash: do not unplug it.
error_fw_shape: This file is not a .sim nor a firmware image.
error_fw_size: This file does not have a firmware's size.
error_fw_vectors: This file is not a Nabaztag firmware.
error_fw_name: Rename the file: letters, digits, dots and dashes only.
error_fw_missing: This image is no longer in the burrow.
error_fw_keep_failed: Could not keep the firmware in the burrow.
